title: Underwriting Guide: Charge Start Date of a Vehicle Added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
For a vehicle added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the charged days of the vehicle addition charge run from a charge start date to the term expiration date. The charge start date depends on when the addition took effect and how promptly it was recorded.

## Rule

The charged days start from a date set as follows, the first matching line deciding:

1. **Addition effective before the current term began.** The charged days start from the term expiration date, so nothing is charged; the vehicle is carried in the term premium already written.
2. **Addition reported in time.** Where the vehicle addition was recorded no more calendar days after its effective date than the package's newly acquired additional report days, the charged days start from that effective date. That is the acquisition date, on which the automatic coverage of a newly acquired vehicle reported in time begins.
3. **Otherwise.** The charged days start from the date the vehicle addition was recorded.

The effective date and the recorded date are those shown on the vehicle addition entry in the policy's transaction history. The term dates are those of the term the addition falls in.

## Report days by package

| Package | Newly acquired additional report days |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | 14 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | 14 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | 14 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 14 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 30 |

## Both sides of the report-day boundary (hypothetical, Cardinal Auto Standard, 14 days)

| Effective date of the addition | Recorded on | Days between | Charge start date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inside the current term, day 0 | Day 14 | 14 | Effective date (day 0) |
| Inside the current term, day 0 | Day 15 | 15 | Recorded date (day 15) |
| Inside the current term, day 0 | Day 0 | 0 | Effective date |
| Before the current term began | Any day | any | Term expiration date: no charged days |

On Cardinal Auto Preferred or Cardinal Auto Premier, the same addition recorded on day 30 starts from the effective date, and on day 31 from the recorded date.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

Take a term running 1 January to 1 July 2026 on Cardinal Auto Plus. A vehicle acquired and effective 2 March 2026 is recorded on 10 March 2026, 8 days later and within 14, so the charged days start on 2 March: 121 calendar days to 1 July. Recorded instead on 20 March, 18 days later, they start on 20 March: 103 calendar days.
